title: Min/max homotopy for the constant-path pullback comparison
statement:
Use small simplicial sets, Kan complexes, products, internal functor simplicial sets, homotopy fibers and weak homotopy equivalences as in [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Let $X,A,Z,C$ be Kan complexes with maps $r:X\to Z$, $u:X\to A$, $f:A\to C$, $v:Z\to C$ satisfying $fu=vr$ strictly. Put
$$Q=A\times_{C,\operatorname{ev}_0}\operatorname{Fun}(\Delta^1,C)\times_{\operatorname{ev}_1,C}Z,$$
let $q:Q\to Z$ be the last projection, and suppose $Q$ is Kan. Define $k:X\to Q$ by $k(x)=(u(x),\operatorname{const}_{fu(x)},r(x))$. For a vertex $z\in Z$, put $F_z=\operatorname{hofib}_z(r)$ and $Q_z=\{z\}\times_ZQ$. Define simplicial maps
$$g_z:F_z\to Q_z,\quad (x,\gamma)\mapsto(u(x),v\gamma,z),$$
$$j_z:Q_z\to\operatorname{hofib}_z(q),\quad y\mapsto(y,\operatorname{const}_z),\qquad h_z:F_z\to\operatorname{hofib}_z(q),\quad(x,\gamma)\mapsto(k(x),\gamma).$$
There is a simplicial homotopy $H_z:F_z\times\Delta^1\to\operatorname{hofib}_z(q)$ from $h_z$ to $j_zg_z$, given by
$$H_z((x,\gamma),t)=\big((u(x),s\mapsto v\gamma(\min(s,t)),\gamma(t)),\ s\mapsto\gamma(\max(s,t))\big).$$
Here $\min,\max:[1]\times[1]\to[1]$ induce maps of nerves $\Delta^1\times\Delta^1\to\Delta^1$; the formula means composition with these maps while retaining the entire simplex parameter of $(x,\gamma)$. The endpoints are exactly $H_z|_{t=0}=h_z$ and $H_z|_{t=1}=j_zg_z$. Empty fibers are allowed.
